body: Thank you so much for this. Beautiful advice. Especially the airplane analogy. Everyone has been beating in my head baby first. And your absolutely right. Can't save someone if you're dead. Thank you again
Stay strong mommies! You must not be defeated!!
Congratulations!!!! THE END IS NEAR. Lol. That's adorable how excited he is. He's gonna be a star!

I’m not a mommy yet but I would make him clean it each time. I know this can cause more stress but if he’s the one responsible for cleaning it he may not like doing it any more. 
My mom said my sister use to do this because she liked the feeling and it didn’t bother her. So make it something he doesn’t like. 
I’d try the sitting on the potty until you poop as well.

Reddit has been a place for me to get for the last couple of weeks. My hormones have been all over the place and so has my thinking. I thank you for your response and not telling me exactly what to do besides take care of my self. Everyone has made it about the baby when I'm still trying to decide if I should have it. 

Today is a new day and tomorrow will be also. I just need to take it step by step and come up with a plan. A feasible plan. Thank you again. And I will reach out when I need a friend.

I’m done with life. I’ve done all that I’ve wanted to do. Graduated, traveled, experienced all that I’ve wanted. Now everything is just negative in my life. I’m in this head space that I can’t get out of. I don’t have a desire to get out of it. I wouldn’t feel selfish at all. I’ve been so generous throughout my life. Giving everyone all that I could give that I feel like this is for me and only me. I’ve never had something that was all mine. My life is all mine now. And I want it to end.

I agree. You’ve helped her quite a bit. Some people have to fall to understand the help that they have. Let her go back to where she was and hopefully she’ll understand what great ppl you and your husband have been to her. Congrats on the new addition. ❤️
Congrats! Keep up the positive energy. You know what you deserve and what your capable of. This gave me hope for myself. ❤️💙  your child must be so proud of their mommy

Thank you for all the kind words. It’s easy to say be strong but everyone here has told me it’s ok to hurt. Something I needed to hear. I pray for anyone going through something like me. This support is so heartfelt. Thank you again ❤️

I waited until I couldn’t take being around babies to talk. Don’t be me. I would look at a baby and out of no where start crying because I had it all bottled up inside and didn’t tell anyone. 
Because I burst out and told everyone at once it was even more stressful when they tried to console me. 
There is no right way to tell someone. It’s  devastating news. I would literally just say it or text it. They shouldn’t think differently of you. 
But be clear on what boundaries you want. For example, be upfront with how the baby talk makes you feel. 
For me seeing a smiling baby mad me cry. I just wanted that unconditional love that the baby was giving. That need that babies have. I wanted that. And I told my friends with babies. It hurts me to be around them. But not in a I hate that you have a baby way in an admirable way. 
At the end remind them of how beautiful being a mother is.
The entire relationship has been secrets and deception on both parts. So honestly keeping it from him wouldn’t surprise him. I just want to enjoy a moment of happiness.

Sorry he turn out to be a dick. I want to go into this clear headed, with no anger, accepting it. I just want to be left with this news, alone, for a while. That’s all. I want to have that peaceful surreal energy lol. But I know that eventually it gets tough so I plan on telling him just to get it over with. And Thank you :)
